claims.claim: RowAddrTranslator supports synchronous and batch sources. Per-unit resolution deduplicates addresses; ScalarIndex retains its original remap API and supplies a streaming default with a bounded materialization fallback. Plugin `load_index` and `load_index_with_remapping` receive the persisted segment version, not just the plugin's newest version. `rust/lance-index-core/src/remapping.rs:259-262,334-362`; `rust/lance-index-core/src/scalar.rs:666-723`; `rust/lance-index/src/scalar/registry.rs:169-209`.

Descriptor traversal supports structs and list/large-list nesting and rejects unsupported containers. Preservation retains existing Managed descriptors, adopts legacy packed/dedicated objects without copying their payload, leaves External descriptors unchanged, and copies inline payload when required. Compaction enables the managed-preservation mode for V2.2/V2.3. `rust/lance/src/dataset/blob.rs:5201-5279,5351-5431`; `rust/lance/src/dataset/optimize.rs:2596-2602`.

The transaction offset now uses field 23. Field 21 is retained as `transaction_section_deprecated`; readers prefer 23 and fall back to 21, while current writers leave 21 unset. This offset is metadata rather than a prerequisite for opening a dataset version. `protos/table.proto:191-208`; `rust/lance-table/src/format/manifest.rs:1067-1070,1148-1149`.

Current V2.2/V2.3 blob writers use managed bases. Managed-part writes spill every nonempty inline payload into independent `_blobs/<uuid>.blob` objects. Managed part reservations still require disjoint blob ID ranges although descriptors encode bases instead of those IDs. Cleanup of a staging target does not imply removal of independent managed objects; ordinary GC and checkpoint coordination apply. `rust/lance/src/dataset/write.rs:118-133,201-204,2453-2458`; `rust/lance/src/dataset/blob.rs:807-835`.

Tagged trim and redundant-segment pruning rederive their result against the latest manifest on retry. A no-op receives a specific conflict marker handled by cleanup. Legacy v0 rebasing accepts the current ordered subsequence produced by trim but refuses unrelated history replacement; the base UUID remains fixed across attempts. `rust/lance/src/io/commit/conflict_resolver.rs:119-155,2718-2788,2956-3025`.

Same-name staged index maintenance may replay only with compatible fields/type. Stable-ID/FRI rewrites retry on concurrently introduced row-ID-domain indices. Commit preparation decodes FRI only when physical columns were actually rewritten, allowing append/add-column paths to carry opaque history. `rust/lance/src/io/commit/conflict_resolver.rs:1084-1100,1594-1618`; `rust/lance/src/io/commit.rs:1553-1574`.

Do not infer universal conflict rejection from the Unknown documentation. Constructing our own Unknown fails, and ordinary operation-specific checks add incompatible branches, but our Clone returns success directly and UpdateBases retains a permissive wildcard. This is a source-level limitation of the broad comment, not a promise that every operation conflicts with unknown history. `rust/lance/src/io/commit/conflict_resolver.rs:446-451,552-618,2344-2390`.

An absent/unknown transaction operation decodes to `Operation::Unknown`. Encoding and manifest application reject Unknown, and JNI conversion rejects it too. A future operation can therefore remain readable as unknown history without becoming a valid new local write. `rust/lance-table/src/transaction/operation.rs:256-261`; `rust/lance-table/src/transaction/proto.rs:404-406,709-715`; `rust/lance-table/src/transaction/manifest_build.rs:760-766`; `java/lance-jni/src/transaction.rs:1220-1222`.

Clone destination preflight permits only a missing dataset/object; authentication or other storage failures propagate. Tagged FRI is no longer a blanket prohibition on Dataset clone: the clone paths relocate its references. The old standalone guard remains a legacy API. `rust/lance/src/dataset.rs:3299-3349,3418-3427`; `rust/lance-table/src/system_index/frag_reuse/metadata.rs:52-70`.

Bitmap now supports merging multiple segments together with new data and one old-data filter per segment. It rejects empty input, filter-count mismatch and mismatched value types; filters retaining nothing avoid old bitmap reads. The old merge function is deprecated and delegates with no new data/no filters. `rust/lance-index/src/scalar/bitmap.rs:661-727,2199-2235`.

IVF flat cosine transformation retains the normalized L2 metric for partition assignment. IVF-RQ rejects Hamming before training. Shuffle scatter validates null/out-of-range partition IDs and omits empty ranges; duplicate columns and worker failures produce errors rather than unchecked assumptions. `rust/lance-index/src/vector/ivf.rs:177-184`; `rust/lance/src/index/vector.rs:1224-1231`; `rust/lance-index/src/vector/v3/shuffler.rs:607-652,893-913,1190-1194`; `rust/lance/src/index/vector/builder.rs:1024-1035,1063-1065`.

Scanner schema projection is public. It resolves matching names/types rather than requiring identical field IDs; incompatible or absent fields fail. Row-ID-only projection no longer adds a row-offset column unnecessarily. `rust/lance/src/dataset/scanner.rs:1619-1622`; `rust/lance-datafusion/src/projection.rs:311-315,351-355`.

Deep managed-blob clone deduplicates `(base ID, URI)` references. Local references retain their relative path; explicit-base objects receive fresh destination paths and rewritten descriptors with local Managed kind. Offset and size remain unchanged. Only blob-containing columns are rewritten, preserving other fragment files. [Focused Key File](../L2-files/rust/lance/src/dataset/blob/clone.rs.md). `rust/lance/src/dataset/blob/clone.rs:30-128,132-259`; `rust/lance/src/io/commit.rs:589-611`.

If transaction serialization fails while checking an ambiguous commit outcome, the result remains Unknown; associated files must be preserved rather than assuming the commit failed. `rust/lance/src/io/commit.rs:284-286`.

Base ID allocation finds a free ID, not a reserved sentinel. UpdateBases excludes zero from new allocation and prevents replacing an existing explicit base when managed blobs are enabled. `rust/lance-table/src/format/manifest.rs:650-667`; `rust/lance-table/src/transaction/manifest_build.rs:1961-1977`.

FRI clone preserves transition wire bytes while patching base references; deep clone localizes bases, shallow clone redirects local references to a newly registered ancestor base and retains existing explicit bases. It refuses unsupported ledgers before copying, creates a fresh index entry, and preserves spilled files after an ambiguous publication outcome. Foreign external-detail bases currently open with default store parameters; per-base credentials are not propagated through this clone path. `rust/lance/src/index/frag_reuse.rs:2185-2320,2335-2415`; `rust/lance/src/io/commit.rs:219-229,423-614,690-730`.

New JSON indices accept scalar values only; inferred arrays/objects and explicit LargeBinary target parameters are rejected. Legacy parameter representation remains. The JSON wrapper still lacks its target's persisted version, so loading passes the target plugin's current version as a documented stand-in; do not claim complete nested-version persistence. `rust/lance-index/src/scalar/json.rs:605-614,934-943,1100-1127`.

Pruning considers derived live coverage and keeps unusable/unknown-coverage segments rather than allowing them to mask useful siblings. Trimming retains provenance from recorded segment bitmaps plus forward dependencies; a missing bitmap warns and cannot pin tagged records; retained wire bytes are preserved. Unknown envelopes prevent trim. `rust/lance/src/dataset/index/frag_reuse.rs:355-450,650-895`.

Blob kinds 4/5 are Managed/ManagedWithBase. Managed resolves relative to the owning descriptor file's table base; ManagedWithBase uses the exact explicit base ID, including 0 and the maximum u32. Their known zero size denotes empty content, unlike the external unknown-size convention. `rust/lance-core/src/datatypes.rs:617-644`.

Managed URIs must be nonempty canonical relative paths: no leading/trailing slash, `://` separator, backslash, empty segment, dot or parent segment. Position plus size must not overflow. Both logical encoding and concatenation validate this contract. `rust/lance-core/src/utils/blob.rs:8-30`; `rust/lance-encoding/src/encodings/logical/blob.rs:340-364`; `rust/lance-file/src/concat.rs:440-452`.
